name: How long does a small drywall repair typically take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a small drywall repair typically take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor patching can often wrap up in a few hours, but proper drywall repair requires adequate drying time between coats of joint compound. Applying compound, letting it dry completely, sanding it flush, and adding texture usually takes one to two days before painting. Rushing the process before the mud dries leads to shrinkage, cracks, or bubbling paint. High indoor humidity or colder conditions can extend mud curing times, so budgeting 24 to 48 hours for a clean, paint-ready finish ensures the compound sets properly without future cracking.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most small drywall repairs take one to two days. While patching is quick, joint compound layers must dry thoroughly between coats before final sanding, texture matching, and painting.
